evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: In this work, we introduce UNICORNS, a benchmark for evaluating the reliability of 3D-LLM responses across four evidence conditions.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Recent 3D Large Language Models (3D-LLMs) have shown strong performance on scene question answering with extensive post-training.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Evaluation of six open-sourced 3D-LLMs reveals a pronounced performance gap: even the strongest zero-shot model achieves 61.22% accuracy on answerable controls, but only 40.94% across the eight challenge categories.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Extensive experiments demonstrate that HORN reaches $75.1 \pm 1.0\%$ across the challenge categories and $77.2 \pm 0.8\%$ overall, outperforming all baselines without degrading answerable-control accuracy.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
